title: Color Wavee
description: Color wave game is very challenging and tests adrenaline. The ball will continue to move without stopping, and you will control the ball to avoid direct collisions with various ball movements so you don't get bored playing this game

title: Metal Guns Fury
description: Control the mightiest soldier and engage other enemies in a fast-paced shooting. Release Date April 2019 Developer Playtouch developed Metal Guns Fury.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Cooking World Reborn
description:
The goal of the game is to go all the way from a small food truck to a large cafe in the center of the airport.

What awaits you:

- More than 50 large levels

- Various improvements to kitchen equipment

- Several game modes

title: Fashion Dye Pro
description: Fashion Dye Pro is a fun-filled shirt DIY game. Follow the hottest summer trends! Tie-dye summer clothing and beach accessories! Show off your creative skills by customizing tie-dye outfits to your liking. Get requests from customers and paint garments at will. Being creative isn't hard: first tie it up, then dye it! Unleash your DIY art cells and leave everything to the dye! Get high this summer! Come join us!

title: Push Push Cat
description: Push Push Cat is a puzzle game where you push and slide cats to rescue! Push the blocks and make a way to save the cute cats who have lost their homes.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fury Tanks
description: Beyond the hills and forests, war waits in silence. When it starts, it’s you, your tank and the enemy in your sights. Build your armor, power up your cannon and let instinct guide your aim. When the ground shakes, make sure it’s because you fired first.

title: Idle Firefighter 3D
description: Idle Firefighter 3D is a single player firefighter simulator game. You will play the role of a firefighter and it is your duty to save the survivors from the fire. Here, new emergencies are constantly occurring and you need to be on standby and must put out the fires as soon as possible! The fire extinguisher is your friend, if the props run out, you will not be able to put out the fire.

title: OUTSIDE
description:
OUTSIDE is a sleek and minimal puzzle game where every move matters. Guide a one-eyed character through a grid to collect the key and reach the exit — but there’s a twist: once you start moving, you won’t stop until you hit a wall.

Plan your route carefully, avoid dead ends, and use the environment to your advantage. With simple mechanics and clean visuals, OUTSIDE is easy to pick up but tough to master — a perfect test of logic and spatial thinking.

title: Fillwords: Find All the Words
description:
Fillwords: Find All the Words - the ultimate word search puzzle for intellectuals and word game enthusiasts! Find the hidden words in the grid of letters. Train your brain, boost your memory, and expand your vocabulary.

Various Themes, every time different word combinations
Enjoy a vibrant and intuitive interface
Use hints
Offline Play: Enjoy the game without the internet connection
Vocabulary enrichment
Suitable for all ages

title: Flick Baseball Super Homerun
description:
Experience various baseball pitches based on the pendulum movement. The ball will fly further if you can hit the ball directly with the quick flick. Experience a “real-life like” batting simulation in this baseball game.
# One Flick Easy Control
You only use flick to control the batting for this game. The more accurate you flick your finger to hit the ball; it is more likely that you will be a home-run hitter.

title: Pin master: Screw puzzle quest & brain games
description: Pin master: Screw puzzle quest & brain games challenges your problem-solving skills in a captivating pin puzzle adventure. Strategically tap to unlock screw holes on products, guiding metal plates to fall in the correct sequence. Navigate through intricate mazes of nuts, bolts, and plates. With each level presenting new challenges, immerse yourself in over 100 brain-teasing stages.

title: Super Onion Boy 2
description: Super Onion Boy 2 is a 2D retro-style adventure game where your mission is to save your friend, who has been captured by a terrible monster with psychic powers. Defeat enemies along the way using superpowers and epic transformations, collect coins and stars to earn extra lives, find chests with magic potions, and defeat all the terrible bosses until you reach the final showdown.

title: Stickman Mega Boss: Battles!
description: Battle hordes of Minecraft mobs! Buy awesome swords and helmets, or unbox them from cases. Take on mega-bosses, unlock different modes, and earn leaderboard points to become the best in this game!

title: Ninja Obby Parkour
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Ninja Obby Parkour, where every level is a test of speed, agility, and strategy. Packed with hundreds of unique obstacle courses, this game combines competitive racing with ninja-style combat and dazzling customization options.

From smashing glass doors at checkpoints with your ninja power to unlocking powerful bonuses like speed boost, giant mode, and flight, every run feels fresh.

title: Fruit Survivor
description: Fruit Survivor is a cool and exciting 3D cartoon survival arcade game. You play as a gardener who is attacked by fruit monsters. You have to fight your way out and destroy them with different weapons. I recommend choosing the blender and maxing it out first. It can deal with many strong enemies effectively. You can also experiment with different weapon combinations to challenge yourself with harder levels. Enjoy hunting fruit monsters!

title: Celebrity Face Dance
description: «Celebrity Face Dance» - an exciting game for girls that combines makeup and dancing. Three celebrities await you, each with their unique style and image. Choose your favorite star and start creating a unique look for her. Use various cosmetic products to enhance beauty and individuality girls. Then, when the makeup is ready, move on to the most exciting part - the dance! Follow the instructions on the screen and mimic the celebrity's moves to become a true dance floor star!

title: Rummy 500 Card Game
description:
Features :
- Offline game.
- 3 Super Modes: classic mode, 3 player mode and Speed mode.
- Auto arrange the cards
- Game statistics.
- Easy to play 
- Excellent and fair ai to play with.
- Continue the last game from where you left.
- No login required

title: Connect Image
description: Play an exciting puzzle game about rainbow friends and other characters! You just need to assemble a picture of the parts.The game is similar to both puzzles and games in the style of "dop". Use logic, turn on your brains, pump attention and ingenuity!

title: Club Tycoon: Idle Clicker
description: Club Tycoon: Idle Clicker is a clicker game where you will manage your own club. Do some clicks to earn money, upgrade abilities to increase efficiency, defend your club from zombie attacks, get resources, and become a club tycoon!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Kitty Scramble: Word Stacks
description: Kitty Scramble is a word puzzle game where you guide a cute kitty to uncover hidden words on the letter-filled board. Enjoy addicting gameplay with numerous challenging puzzles that test your word skills.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Apple Worm
description: Play Apple Worm now. This is a classic puzzle game with simple operation. Brain-burning levels make you love it! Control a cute little worm whose goal is to eat the apple and upgrade. Upgrading allows you to unlock more cute skins. You can also earn rewards by completing challenges. Unlock Auto ATK, Summoning, etc. Enter the snakey mode. Control your worm and eat the apples. Go through the obstacles and enter the portal without any problems!

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

title: Bubble Shooter Remastered
description: Shoot groups of bubbles and form groups to make them pop. Form groups of 3 or more bubbles of the same color to make the bubbles explode.

title: Zumba Quest
description: Explore a vibrant world with never-ending puzzles and diverse environments in each chapter. Push your limits with exciting timed challenges with special types of marbles to help you along the way. Unlock new marble shooters as you advance through exciting levels.

title: Stickman Rocket
description: You have a powerful cannon loaded with Stickman Ragdols which you must shoot far to reach your target! Solve all kinds of challenges as you collect gems, avoid obstacles and control your throws to reach the targets in each level. Try not to bump into obstacles along the way and use all the raggedy characters you need to have fun with these amazing challenges - good luck!

title: Hidden Object Adventure
description: Are you ready to solve puzzles and uncover hidden secrets? Become a detective in Find Hidden Object Game and test your observation skills! Explore detailed scenes in schools, houses, amusement parks, and zoos. Search for cleverly hidden items, challenge your brain, and enjoy fun, relaxing gameplay. Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers alike. Train your mind and become the ultimate detective!

title: Mission Santa: Deliver the Gifts
description:
Santa must deliver gifts to children in time! There are many kids and only one Santa, so everything has to be done on the fly! Fly in a sleigh on Christmas night and throw gifts down chimneys to make children happy. 

The game helps you feel the atmosphere of the approaching holiday and prepare for the most magical time of the year!

title: 100 Hidden Capybaras
description: Are you ready for a hidden object game that's as cute as it is challenging? Jump into "100 Hidden Capybaras" – the ultimate hidden object adventure where your mission is to find and collect 100 adorable capybaras, each hiding in beautifully designed scenes! Explore stunning environments filled with lush forests, charming villages, secret dungeons, and unknown planets. Discover all hiding spots for our fluffy friends as you put your observation skills to the test.

title: Color Nonogram Puzzle 2
description: Relaxing Color Nonogram is a vibrant logic puzzle game where every grid reveals stunning pixel art. Solve colorful nonogram challenges, train your brain, and enjoy a calm, stress-free experience. Perfect for fans of Picross and classic logic puzzles, this free nonogram game blends strategy, creativity, and relaxation. Discover hundreds of levels, improve focus, and unwind anytime with satisfying color puzzle gameplay designed for both beginners and experts.

title: Roof Car Stunt
description: Challenging car game where you drive and collect coins. Jump around ramps, drive through various obstacles and drive into a giant pink donut to complete the level!

title: Jelly Run 2048
description: Jelly Run 2048 is a challenging casual puzzle game that combines the classic 2048 number merging with exciting parkour gameplay. Guide your jelly block by swiping left or right to connect and disconnect cubes. Merge cubes to get double the number, reaching 2048 or greater. When the jelly block collides with tiles of the same number, they merge into a larger number.

title: Dunk Challenge
description: Shoot and score with Dunk Challenge, a 2D basketball game that will make you bounce with joy. You will play as a basketball shooter. You will also enjoy a new explosive mode that adds more fun and challenge to your gameplay. You will tap the screen to shoot and use your 14 bullets wisely to make the ball rebound and land in the hoop. You will also collect purple diamonds and explore the store, where you can find 15 different ball skins to customize your game. Don’t miss this addictive game!

title: Brain Test: One Line Draw Puzzle
description: In this engaging one-line puzzle game, challenge your brain by drawing shapes in a single stroke without lifting your finger. Each level presents a unique shape that must be drawn in one continuous line, testing your logic and creativity. With increasing difficulty, you’ll need to plan your moves carefully to solve each puzzle. Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers hours of fun while improving problem-solving skills. Can you master the art of drawing each shape in one go?

title: ROYAL COIN RUSH
description: Drag adjacent coins to swap them, and line up three or more vertically or horizontally to remove them. Special coins appear when 4 or more coins are matched. Mix effects by combining special items! The stage is cleared when all the target coins are erased.

title: Car Racing 3D Drive Mad
description: Here is a car racing arcade game. You have a chance to control a car equiped with nitro system. You can collect the fuel to charge it. Try to defeat other AI players by avoiding obstacles and using nitro items. Have a good time!

title: Army Defence Dino Shoot
description: Army Defence Dino Shoot is a third-person defense idle game. It seems that a lot of dinosaurs surround you. To protect the base from incoming dinosaurs, you can summon more soldiers and engineers to create a defensive line. Don't forget to upgrade your weapons, damage, and fire rate skills. The longer you hold this position, the more dinosaurs you will meet. Have a good time building a military base.

title: Ship & Fish
description: Ship & Fish is an exciting survival game where the player controls a ship and tries to stay alive by avoiding dangerous fish. The game requires fast reflexes and smart movement, as fish attack from all directions. The longer you survive, the higher your score grows and the more challenging the game becomes.

title: Spooky Chains
description: Spooky Chains is a fun Halloween puzzle game. Tap a tile and drag through matching nearby items to make a chain of 3 or more. The items vanish, and the tiles turn golden. Your goal is to turn all tiles golden. Sometimes a Flying Witch glides across the board. Tap her while she flies to watch a reward ad. After the ad, she blasts some tiles into golden. You can also watch a reward ad to remove the timer and play without time pressure.

title: Archer: Dungeon Hero
description: A fast-paced fantasy roguelike where an archer battles waves of monsters, unlocks abilities, and creates a unique build during every run.

title: Squad Assembler
description:
Assemble a cool squad and see who wins!
Combine items to improve the fighters' equipment! Combine weapons and armor, buy loot boxes with new weapons!
You can create cool, unique characters, each of which will have certain skills! Buy parts for your fighters, change their arms, torso, head! Create real cyborgs to defeat the enemy! Merge armor and weapons, increase the levels and characteristics of items. Hire cool heroes who will help you in tough battles.

title: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game
description: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game lets you build your perfect movie theater and run a profitable business. Choose the best films to satisfy guests and increase income. Expand parking, open snack kiosks, automate processes, and hire employees to optimize operations. Complete over 50 missions, enjoy colorful 3D graphics, and immerse yourself in a unique atmosphere. Buy movies, prepare snacks, and grow your theater to attract more viewers. Ready to become the top drive-in owner?

title: Santa Vs Skritch
description:
Everyone is busy celebrating Christmas and enjoying the holidays. But a critical showdown is happening somewhere in the woods!

Play against a friend or family member or challenge the AI to a duel. Do your best to kick the present past your opponent and score!

Will you help Santa or the Skritch? Come play now and show off your skills!

title: CrazyZombies 3D
description:
Crazy Zombies 3D is a fast-paced top-down zombie survival shooter with cartoon-style 3D graphics. Use 10+ weapons to fight endless waves of zombies, conquer a town map, and unlock powerful upgrades. Battle 5 zombie types and 4 deadly bosses with unique abilities. Customize your loadout and survive as long as you can. Fun, intense, and addictive—can you survive the apocalypse?

?- Zombie Survival
?- 10+ Weapons to Master
?️- Conquer the Town
?- Boss Battles
?- Fun, Fast & Addictive

title: HeroBall Adventures 2
description: It’s time to embark on a brand new adventure in this great game, this time in a spherical theme! Heroball Adventures 2 is finally here! It’s a fun game where heroball has to save his friends who were abducted by a strange machine on an otherwise calm day. Control the character, jump over obstacles and try to save all of your friends. Be sure to try to get to the end of each level. Collect points and unlock new abilities!

title: The Trendy Mermaid
description: Embark on an exciting journey of makeup, accessories, and fashion to help Ariel make an unforgettable comeback. With a wide selection of clothes, makeup, and accessories, help Ariel become the trendiest mermaid ever. Enjoy making her look dreamy and fabulous - The Trendy Mermaid is free to play for every girl.

title: Bomb Head Hot Potato
description:
In the game "Bomb Head - Hot Potato" your goal is to stay alive and not die from the bomb in your hand. Drop bombs on your opponents to win! 
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of "Bomb Head - Hot Potato" and prove your survival skills and tactical thinking!

title: Sniper Shooter 2
description: Aim and Shoot! Kill the bad guys and accomplish missions to become the master hitman. Just turn your device to aim and TAP TO SHOOT and kill.

title: Sky Maze Challenge
description: Perfect your jumps, defy gravity, and showcase your unmatched eye-hand coordination. Sky Maze Challenge demands precision and timing to overcome all of the traps and obstacles to conquer

title: Fill & Sort Puzzle
description: Fill & Sort Puzzle is a cozy puzzle game where players have to sort, stack, and pleasantlarrange household items while watching for a naughty cat who likes to make things messy!  Many small details need to be paid attention to in the levels. For example, when organizing the shoe rack, don’t forget to clean the dirty shoes before storing them. Do you need a hint? Watch the video for tips.

title: Gold Miner Tower Defense
description: Gold Miner Tower Defense is a wonderful combination of tower defense, card strategy and upgrade combat. You will play as a brave miner protecting gold from enemies. Protect your precious treasures strategically with many unique defense towers!

title: Plane Crash Ragdoll Simulator
description: As a fearless pilot, your mission is simple: survive a relentless onslaught of rockets targeting your aircraft. Take the controls of a variety of planes and helicopters, each with unique skins to unlock and customize. Your goal is to navigate through perilous skies and bring your aircraft to the ground without crashing. But be warned: if you touch the ground, your aircraft will be exploded!

title: Football Stars Championship
description: Try a fresh take on a football game! The luck-based gameplay will keep you on your toes. Score extra points with precise shots that avoid the goalkeeper perfectly.

title: Horse Racing Derby Quest
description: Become a horse jockey and win the intense derby races against other jockeys.Release DateMarch 2018 (Android)November 2018 (iOS)November 2019 (HTML5)DeveloperPlaytouch developed Horse Racing Derby Quest.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: BlockBuster Puzzle
description: BlockBuster Puzzle is a Tetris-like game where you match colorful blocks so they disappear from the game screen. Unlock new realms and challenges as you progress, enjoying vibrant graphics and immersive gameplay.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Supermarket Sort N Match
description: In 'Supermarket Sort n Match,' rearrange items between shelves to match 3 identical items on one shelf, clearing it and allowing upper shelves to slide down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves. Collect all items before time runs out as difficulty increases with each level. Enjoy the ultimate item-sorting and matching challenge!

title: Portals
description: Portals - HTML5 adventure-puzzle game where two heroes, one black and one white, are stranded on a mysterious planet filled with portals after being swallowed by a black hole. Your mission is to guide them through a series of challenging levels, utilizing their unique abilities to navigate this portal-filled world and find their way home. With intriguing puzzles, captivating graphics, and an immersive storyline, Portals offers a thrilling gaming experience for players of all ages.

title: Uphill Rush 13
description: Introducing the new, thirteenth game in the Uphill Rush series, and this time in a new setting - a Water Park! Dive into (pun intended) the atmosphere of water fun, riding different types of tubes, surfboards and even jet skis! Unlock new power-ups and skins by overcoming obstacles, such as loops and long jumps. But don't be scared of them, they are your best friends when it comes to stunts, which give you bonuses! Not to mention, make you look insanely cool.

title: Family Squid Challenge
description: Hey Player, bring your friend along and team up in this Squid adventure! There are black and red masked men everywhere, so you must be very careful. Run from them and collect the keys to complete the level. Be cautious — both of you need to survive!

title: Soccer Duel
description: An exciting game in the style of table football, which you can play both alone and with friends on the same device or over the network.

title: Draw Bridge Challenge
description: Drag to create a path and guide the car to the goal! You can only draw the line once, be careful not to break the car! To become a good bridge builder, you just need to drag with one finger to draw a bridge that is stable enough for the car to reach flags. You can draw a bridge on only one line, so make sure safety comes first.

title: Devil Dash
description: Level Devil Dash is ready to break the ultimate limit within your inner demon rage! Prepare for a hellish journey that demands top-notch improvisation skills and extreme patience. You will embark on an adventure through interconnected worlds, tightly linked to one another.

title: Girly Puzzle
description: Place blocks on the grid to form vertical or horizontal rows. When no more blocks can be placed, the game is over. Collect items to increase Your Score!

title: BFFs K-Pop Fangirls
description: This exciting game lets you follow the day-to-day life of two real K-pop fangirls. During the day they keep up with their professional lives, but when the clock stickers 6 PM, they gear up in fashionable combat outfits and chase their favorite K-pop idols throughout the city. Get it started, and have a blast mixing and matching different clothing items, hairstyles, and accessories to create the perfect looks for our best friends. Show off your fashion skills by dressing up your favorite girls.

title: Sort And Style: Back To School
description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

title: Flower Fairy Adventure Story
description: Welcome to Flower Fairy Adventure Story, a casual puzzle game that you can play for free. Flower Fairy lost her wings! Embark on an adventure where you solve each tiny jigsaw, dress up your girl in pretty clothes, and pave the way for the Flower Fairy. Practice your observation, logical thinking, and hands-on ability while enjoying the relaxing and captivating puzzle game.

title: Traffic Jam Hop On
description: In Traffic Jam: Hop On, challenge your strategy thinking and quick reflexes! This wonderful puzzle game will take you into a colorful parking lot. Your task is to help all kinds of vehicles get out of traffic jams and start smoothly.

title: Merge Town!
description: Ever wanted to be Mayor? Ever wanted to run a town, develop the land, and see a metropolis grow? Well, look no further than Merge Town!, the newest title from Gram Games. The concept of the game is simple - you have a plot of land, and it’s your job to turn it into a town. Every so often, you’ll be gifted with a house. Each house can be merged with other houses of the same variety to form a bigger home.

title: Winter Solitaire TriPeaks
description:
Take a break from the holiday bustle and unwind with Winter Solitaire TriPeaks!
Play over 500 frosty levels and clear shimmering, ice-covered tableaus. Escape into a peaceful winter wonderland filled with enchanting scenes that evolve as you build magical locations throughout the game. From a cozy cottage to a snow-dusted palace, every setting is a feast for the eyes.

Discover the most heart-warming Solitaire experience of the season — and let the snowflakes guide your cards to victory!

title: Bobb's World
description: Bobb's World is an arcade game where you play as Bobb, who is very hungry and wants to eat all the food in the universe! Help him to go from planet to planet to eat all the food.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Hide Moodeng Hippo!
description:
Evil flea balls are raining down from above, and it's your job to keep the adorable baby hippo, Moodeng, safe! 
Tap on various objects in each level to activate, building a sturdy shelter for Moodeng. 


Key Features:
- 50+ levels of exciting and brain-teasing puzzles.
- Physics-based gameplay where every move counts.
- Fun, adorable 2D graphics and engaging challenges.
- A variety of objects to interact with, providing endless strategies for success.

title: Zindex
description:
You are in an epidemic-stricken zone. The streets are filled with hordes of hungry zombies, and the survivors have long since abandoned this place. Your only hope for rescue is to repair an abandoned radio tower and call for help.
Explore dangerous locations, scavenge houses, crates, and closets in search of valuable resources. Gather materials to craft weapons, tools, and essential items. Fight zombies in melee combat or use firearms—the choice is yours.

title: Mind Games: Math Crosswords
description:
Mind Games: Math Crosswords is a game to improve your math skills. It is a great way to spend your time. 
The player's mission is to save the planet from extinction. The aliens have destroyed all the plants on the planet. However, humans have found a solution. Engineers have built ships that convert brain activity into life-giving energy to grow plants. By solving mathematical problems, you are contributing to the restoration of plants and the regeneration of our planet.

title: Space Survivor
description: Jump right into the action, fighting dangerous aliens and executing amazing maneuvers! Sharpen your weapons and skills, you will need them to last as long as possible.

title: Stickman Leave Prison
description: You take control of two characters in Stickman Leave jail, a new entry in the stickman jail series. Your goal is to guide them to the level's finish as they search for the corresponding colored keys to unlock the door. The objective is to evade capture by the guards. Collect money spread over the level to unlock new, more skilled skins. As you go around the game, leap and avoid harmful things to arrive safely.

title: Vex X3M
description:
VEX X3M, a new extreme hill racing game with bike stunts and obstacles, is here! 
Enjoy the classic Vex elements, but this time you will be racing your way to the finish line! 

Perform crazy bike stunts in 30 unique levels filled with danger - from spikes and shooting knives to rockets and lasers. Reach the finish safely and obtain stars to unlock new unique bike skins.

Complete all levels in easy and hard mode to crown yourself a master VEX X3M Rider.

Start your engines and enjoy VEX X3M!

title: Escape from the Portal
description:
"Your soul is trapped between worlds. The only way home is to activate an ancient portal... but only one can pass through."
Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld.

title: HomeRun Derby
description: Step up to the plate and experience the excitement of Baseball's exhilarating Home Run Derby! Swing your bat and aim for the fences to hit as many home runs as you can. Time your swings carefully to score big points and keep the crowd cheering! How many home runs can you hit in a row? Test your skills and see if you can become the ultimate Home Run champion!

title: Ragdoll Mega Dunk
description:
Welcome to the Ragdoll Mega Dunk indoor extreme basketball club! The game is a cool Ragdoll style basketball simulator .
Every attempt to do a trick will be unique! Throw the ball into the basket and fly there yourself!

title: Dummies World Cup
description: Dummies World Cup is a fun HTML5 football game for all ages! Choose your favorite team from 32 national squads and control your silly dummy player on a mini soccer field. Score goals, enjoy simple controls, and have fast-paced football fun. Easy to play, perfect for kids and families!

title: Little master of assembly
description: The gameplay of this game is puzzle assembly type, mainly according to the room suggested by the picture, according to the objects in the room, the use of parts to splice the room objects

title: Fashion World Simulator
description: It's time for some super cool styles! Be a fabulous fashionista stylist and dress up a supermodel to rule all the fashion runways around the world! Get ready to dive into the ultimate dress-up experience and show your creativity. This game is all about makeovers, dress-ups, and decorating new cool stuff. Compete and vote for your style to win the competition. Join us and start your fashion journey!

title: Bubble it jam
description: Bubble it jam is a vibrant, fast-paced puzzle-shooter game where players aim and shoot colored balls to match and pop clusters of the same color.the goal is to collect color bubble, free the ropes, and complete each level. Every stage presents a new and exciting challenge, keeping gameplay fresh and engaging, combining strategy, quick reflexes, and a bit of luck for high scores.

title: Bunny Blox
description: Help the Bunny collect as many blox as possible. Match 3 or more items. Slide left or right to move the item. Slide up to rotate and slide down to drop the item. Special rewards appear during the game. Use them wisely to destroy strategic areas.

title: Tile Guru
description: Tile Guru is a casual puzzle tile-matching game that combines mental sharpness with relaxation. Spend just 10 minutes a day matching vibrant 3D tiles and finding new fruit designs while mastering strategic match flips.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Escape the Alien Prison
description:
You have suddenly woken up trapped inside a massive, high-tech spaceship deep in the cosmos, and there is only one objective: break out! Escape the Alien Prison is an epic sci-fi survival and parkour adventure where you must fight your way to freedom. Navigate dangerous obstacle courses, hack complex security systems, and take down extraterrestrial threats. 
The complete story campaign, puzzles, collectibles, and progression are available in Single Player Mode.

title: Sorting frogs
description: A game in the sorting genre, but in the form of sorting frogs, great graphics, very many levels, and a large variety of frogs. Several variations of levels. Pass levels, get achievements, unlock new kinds of frogs!

title: Relax Mini Games Collection
description: This is a collection of creative and fun mini-games. The game contains a variety of modes, you can DIY ice cream, have cooking for mooncakes, design a car of your favorite, and so on. You cant miss our game if you want to find some relaxation in your busy life.

title: Pops Quest
description: In this story-based platformer, you'll step into the shoes of a heroic protagonist driven by an undying love for their child. Experience the perfect fusion of action and platforming as Pop's Quest takes you on a high-octane adventure. With its fast-paced gameplay levels designed, you'll be engrossed in a world that demands agility, strategy, and quick reflexes. As you progress, you'll be emotionally invested and driven to save your child from danger.

title: Tank Battle: War Commander
description: Tank Battle: War Commander is an epic turn based strategy game in which you must choose to fight for either the Axis or Allied powers during World War 2. Whichever side you choose, you must fight to repel the enemy invasion and eradicate their forces.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: 2-3-4 Player Games
description: These games can be played with 2, 3, or 4 players. You can play 21 unique games with your friends, each with different scenarios. The objective of each game is to either score or be the first to reach the finish line. Move swiftly and outpace your opponents! It's time to enjoy with friends!

title: DuaLight - A Reflected Game
description:
DuaLight is a challenging 2D pixel art hyper-casual platformer. The true path lies in the reflection. 

Navigate levels where the real world tricks your eyes, and only those who watch the reflection below can move forward. Minimalist and short.

In DuaLight – A Reflected Game, nothing is as it seems… or rather, everything only appears in the reflection. You control a character in a world where invisible platforms can’t be seen in the real world, but only in the reflection below the screen.

title: Sort Game Toy Sort
description: Enjoy some adorable sorting fun in Sort Game: Toy Sort. This delightful match 3 puzzle and casual sort game challenges you to organize colorful dolls and toys. Match and eliminate all dolls within the limited time. When you encounter difficulties, use items to help you quickly clear the level. Such as Convert, Eliminate, Refresh or Break.

title: Antistress Relaxation Box

title: Tank Sniper 3D

Tank Sniper 3D: The Ultimate Shooting Game

Some people just want to eat — others are only pretending to be human.

Your mission is to maintain a secure environment by identifying suspicious passengers, spotting fake passports, and uncovering hidden contraband using cutting-edge X-ray machines.
